page.layout: One printed page of text in one block, with a woodcut floral ornament centred below it. No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword are visible. The strong mirrored and inverted lines at the top and in the middle are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is very faint. The strongest lines on the page are mirrored and upside down, which is show-through from the other side, so the recto text cannot be read reliably. The illegible markers are placeholders for faint printed lines in the body of the page; their word counts are estimates and they do not reproduce the printed wording. The woodcut ornament below the text block is not text and is not transcribed. A larger faint heading may sit near the top left, but it cannot be read. A higher-resolution or better-lit scan of the recto would be needed for a full transcription.
